     1→# CLAUDE.md
     2→
     3→This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
     4→
     5→## Commands
     6→
     7→```bash
     8→npm run dev      # start dev server (Vite, default port 5173/5174)
     9→npm run build    # tsc type-check + Vite production build
    10→npm run lint     # ESLint
    11→npm run preview  # serve the production build locally
    12→```
    13→
    14→No test framework is configured.
    15→
    16→## Architecture
    17→
    18→Single-page React app with two views — **Setup** and **Grid** — controlled by a `view` state string in `App.tsx`. No router.
    19→
    20→### Data flow
    21→
    22→1. `Setup` collects a Figma Personal Access Token (persisted to `localStorage`) and a file URL.
    23→2. `parseFigmaUrl` (`src/lib/figma.ts`) extracts the `fileKey` from any Figma URL format (`/file/`, `/design/`, `/proto/`).
    24→3. `useFigmaFile` hook calls the Figma REST API: `GET /v1/files/{fileKey}?depth=2` to get all pages and their top-level `FRAME`/`COMPONENT` nodes, then `GET /v1/images/{fileKey}` in batches of 50 to fetch PNG thumbnails.
    25→4. `ScreenGrid` renders the results with page-tab filtering and name search. Each `ScreenCard` opens a prototype jump URL on click.
    26→
    27→### Figma prototype URL format
    28→
    29→```
    30→https://www.figma.com/proto/{fileKey}/{slug}?node-id={nodeId}&scaling=contain&hide-ui=1
    31→```
    32→
    33→Node IDs from the API use `:` (e.g. `1:23`) — these must be replaced with `-` for prototype URLs.
    34→
    35→### Styling
    36→
    37→All styles are in `src/index.css` (no CSS modules, no Tailwind). Design tokens are CSS custom properties on `:root`. Fonts are IBM Plex Mono (body/mono) and Syne (display/headings), loaded from Google Fonts in `index.html`.
    38→
    39→### TypeScript strictness
    40→
    41→`tsconfig.app.json` enables `strict`, `noUnusedLocals`, and `noUnusedParameters`. The build (`tsc -b`) will fail on unused variables.
    42→
```

     1→import type { FigmaFileResponse, FigmaImagesResponse } from '../types';
     2→
     3→const BASE = 'https://api.figma.com/v1';
     4→
     5→async function req<T>(path: string, token: string): Promise<T> {
     6→  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
     7→    headers: { 'X-Figma-Token': token },
     8→  });
     9→  if (!res.ok) {
    10→    const text = await res.text();
    11→    throw new Error(`Figma API ${res.status}: ${text}`);
    12→  }
    13→  return res.json();
    14→}
    15→
    16→export function fetchFile(fileKey: string, token: string): Promise<FigmaFileResponse> {
    17→  return req<FigmaFileResponse>(`/files/${fileKey}?depth=2`, token);
    18→}
    19→
    20→export function fetchImages(
    21→  fileKey: string,
    22→  nodeIds: string[],
    23→  token: string,
    24→  scale = 1
    25→): Promise<FigmaImagesResponse> {
    26→  const ids = nodeIds.map(encodeURIComponent).join(',');
    27→  return req<FigmaImagesResponse>(
    28→    `/images/${fileKey}?ids=${ids}&format=png&scale=${scale}`,
    29→    token
    30→  );
    31→}
    32→
    33→/** Parse a Figma URL to extract fileKey and optional nodeId */
    34→export function parseFigmaUrl(url: string): { fileKey: string; nodeId?: string } | null {
    35→  try {
    36→    const u = new URL(url);
    37→    // matches /file/, /design/, /proto/
    38→    const match = u.pathname.match(/\/(file|design|proto)\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
    39→    if (!match) return null;
    40→    const fileKey = match[2];
    41→    const nodeId = u.searchParams.get('node-id') ?? undefined;
    42→    return { fileKey, nodeId };
    43→  } catch {
    44→    return null;
    45→  }
    46→}
    47→
    48→/** Build a prototype jump URL for a given node */
    49→export function buildProtoUrl(fileKey: string, nodeId: string, fileName: string): string {
    50→  const slug = fileName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-');
    51→  // Figma proto URLs use dashes in node-id
    52→  const safeNodeId = nodeId.replace(/:/g, '-');
    53→  return `https://www.figma.com/proto/${fileKey}/${slug}?node-id=${safeNodeId}&scaling=contain&hide-ui=1`;
    54→}
    55→
```

     1→import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { fetchFile, fetchImages, buildProtoUrl } from '../lib/figma';
     3→import type { ScreenFrame, FigmaConfig } from '../types';
     4→
     5→interface State {
     6→  loading: boolean;
     7→  error: string | null;
     8→  fileName: string;
     9→  screens: ScreenFrame[];
    10→  progress: string;
    11→}
    12→
    13→export function useFigmaFile() {
    14→  const [state, setState] = useState<State>({
    15→    loading: false,
    16→    error: null,
    17→    fileName: '',
    18→    screens: [],
    19→    progress: '',
    20→  });
    21→
    22→  const load = useCallback(async (config: FigmaConfig) => {
    23→    setState(s => ({ ...s, loading: true, error: null, screens: [], progress: 'Fetching file…' }));
    24→
    25→    try {
    26→      const file = await fetchFile(config.fileKey, config.token);
    27→
    28→      // Collect all top-level FRAME nodes across all pages
    29→      const frames: Array<{ id: string; name: string; pageId: string; pageName: string }> = [];
    30→      for (const page of file.document.children) {
    31→        for (const node of page.children ?? []) {
    32→          if (node.type === 'FRAME' || node.type === 'COMPONENT') {
    33→            frames.push({ id: node.id, name: node.name, pageId: page.id, pageName: page.name });
    34→          }
    35→        }
    36→      }
    37→
    38→      if (frames.length === 0) {
    39→        throw new Error('No frames found in this file. Make sure the file has top-level frames.');
    40→      }
    41→
    42→      setState(s => ({
    43→        ...s,
    44→        progress: `Loading thumbnails for ${frames.length} screens…`,
    45→      }));
    46→
    47→      // Figma limits image requests; batch in chunks of 50
    48→      const CHUNK = 50;
    49→      const imageMap: Record<string, string> = {};
    50→      for (let i = 0; i < frames.length; i += CHUNK) {
    51→        const chunk = frames.slice(i, i + CHUNK);
    52→        const ids = chunk.map(f => f.id);
    53→        const result = await fetchImages(config.fileKey, ids, config.token, 1);
    54→        Object.assign(imageMap, result.images);
    55→        setState(s => ({
    56→          ...s,
    57→          progress: `Loading thumbnails… ${Math.min(i + CHUNK, frames.length)}/${frames.length}`,
    58→        }));
    59→      }
    60→
    61→      const screens: ScreenFrame[] = frames.map(f => ({
    62→        id: f.id,
    63→        name: f.name,
    64→        pageId: f.pageId,
    65→        pageName: f.pageName,
    66→        thumbnailUrl: imageMap[f.id] ?? undefined,
    67→        protoUrl: buildProtoUrl(config.fileKey, f.id, file.name),
    68→      }));
    69→
    70→      setState({
    71→        loading: false,
    72→        error: null,
    73→        fileName: file.name,
    74→        screens,
    75→        progress: '',
    76→      });
    77→    } catch (e: unknown) {
    78→      setState({
    79→        loading: false,
    80→        error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unknown error',
    81→        fileName: '',
    82→        screens: [],
    83→        progress: '',
    84→      });
    85→    }
    86→  }, []);
    87→
    88→  return { ...state, load };
    89→}
    90→
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
     1→# CLAUDE.md
     2→
     3→This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
     4→
     5→## Commands
     6→
     7→```bash
     8→npm run dev      # start dev server (Vite, tries 5173+ until a free port is found)
     9→npm run build    # tsc type-check + Vite production build
    10→npm run lint     # ESLint
    11→npm run preview  # serve the production build locally
    12→```
    13→
    14→No test framework is configured.
    15→
    16→## Architecture
    17→
    18→Single-page React app with two views — **Setup** and **Grid** — controlled by a `view` state string in `App.tsx`. No router.
    19→
    20→### Data flow
    21→
    22→1. `Setup` collects a Figma Personal Access Token (persisted to `localStorage`) and a file URL.
    23→2. `parseFigmaUrl` (`src/lib/figma.ts`) extracts the `fileKey` from any Figma URL format (`/file/`, `/design/`, `/proto/`).
    24→3. `useFigmaFile` hook calls the Figma REST API: `GET /v1/files/{fileKey}?depth=2` to get all pages and their top-level `FRAME`/`COMPONENT` nodes, then `GET /v1/images/{fileKey}` in batches of 50 to fetch PNG thumbnails.
    25→4. `ScreenGrid` renders the results with page-tab filtering and name search. Each `ScreenCard` opens a prototype jump URL on click.
    26→
    27→### State and view transitions
    28→
    29→- `App.tsx` uses `effectiveView` to guard the grid: if `load()` throws or returns no screens, it stays on `setup` even though `setView('grid')` was called.
    30→- The Figma token is persisted to `localStorage` under the key `figview:token` (see `Setup.tsx:TOKEN_KEY`).
    31→- `FigmaConfig.protoFileKey` exists in `types.ts` but is not currently populated or used anywhere.
    32→
    33→### Figma prototype URL format
    34→
    35→```
    36→https://www.figma.com/proto/{fileKey}/{slug}?node-id={nodeId}&scaling=contain&hide-ui=1
    37→```
    38→
    39→Node IDs from the API use `:` (e.g. `1:23`) — these must be replaced with `-` for prototype URLs.
    40→
    41→### Styling
    42→
    43→All styles are in `src/index.css` (no CSS modules, no Tailwind). Design tokens are CSS custom properties on `:root`. Fonts are IBM Plex Mono (body/mono) and Syne (display/headings), loaded from Google Fonts in `index.html`.
    44→
    45→### TypeScript strictness
    46→
    47→`tsconfig.app.json` enables `strict`, `noUnusedLocals`, and `noUnusedParameters`. The build (`tsc -b`) will fail on unused variables.
    48→
```
</details></tool-use>

     1→import { useState } from 'react';

     5→interface Props {

     8→}

    10→export function ScreenCard({ screen, index }: Props) {
    11→  const [imgLoaded, setImgLoaded] = useState(false);
    12→  const [imgError, setImgError] = useState(false);
    13→
    14→  const handleClick = () => {
    15→    window.open(screen.protoUrl, '_blank', 'noopener');
    16→  };
    17→
    18→  return (
    19→    <article
    20→      className="screen-card"
    21→      data-kind={screen.kind}
    22→      onClick={handleClick}
    23→      style={{ '--delay': `${index * 30}ms` } as CSSProperties}
    24→      title={`Jump to: ${screen.name}`}
    25→    >
    26→      <div className="screen-thumb">
    27→        {!imgError && screen.thumbnailUrl ? (
    28→          <>
    29→            {!imgLoaded && <div className="thumb-skeleton" />}
    30→            <img
    31→              src={screen.thumbnailUrl}
    32→              alt={screen.name}
    33→              onLoad={() => setImgLoaded(true)}
    34→              onError={() => setImgError(true)}
    35→              style={{ opacity: imgLoaded ? 1 : 0 }}
    36→            />
    37→          </>
    38→        ) : (
    39→          <div className="thumb-placeholder">
    40→            <span className="thumb-placeholder-icon">⬜</span>
    41→          </div>
    42→        )}
    43→
    44→        <div className="thumb-bottom">
    45→          <div className="thumb-title" title={screen.name}>
    46→            {screen.name}
    47→          </div>
    48→          <div className="thumb-page">{screen.pageName}</div>
    49→        </div>
    50→
    51→        <div className="screen-overlay">
    52→          <span className="overlay-cta">View Prototype ↗</span>
    53→        </div>
    54→      </div>
    55→    </article>
    56→  );
    57→}
    58→

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { parseFigmaUrl } from '../lib/figma';
import type { FigmaConfig } from '../types';

interface Props {
  onLoad: (config: FigmaConfig) => void;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  progress: string;
  fileName: string;
}

const TOKEN_KEY = 'figview:token';

export function Setup({ onLoad, loading, error, progress, fileName }: Props) {
  const [token, setToken] = useState('');
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('');
  const [urlError, setUrlError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
    if (saved) setToken(saved);
  }, []);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setUrlError('');

    const parsed = parseFigmaUrl(url.trim());
    if (!parsed) {
      setUrlError('Invalid Figma URL. Paste a /file/, /design/, or /proto/ link.');
      return;
    }

    localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token.trim());
    onLoad({ token: token.trim(), fileKey: parsed.fileKey, rawUrl: url.trim() });
  };

  return (
    <header className="top-section">
      <div className="top-header">
        <span className="setup-eyebrow">— prototype navigator</span>
        <h1 className="setup-title">figview</h1>
        {fileName && <p className="loaded-filename">{fileName}</p>}
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="setup-form">
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="token">Access Token</label>
          <input
            id="token"
            type="password"
            value={token}
            onChange={e => setToken(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="figd_…"
            required
            autoComplete="off"
            spellCheck={false}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="field field--url">
          <label htmlFor="url">Figma File URL</label>
          <input
            id="url"
            type="url"
            value={url}
            onChange={e => { setUrl(e.target.value); setUrlError(''); }}
            placeholder="https://www.figma.com/file/…"
            required
            spellCheck={false}
          />
          {urlError && <span className="field-error">{urlError}</span>}
        </div>

        <div className="field field--action">
          <label aria-hidden="true">&nbsp;</label>
          <button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="btn-load">
            {loading ? progress || 'Loading…' : 'Load Screens →'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {error && <div className="error-banner">{error}</div>}
    </header>
  );
}

```

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { ScreenCard } from './ScreenCard';
import type { ScreenFrame } from '../types';

interface Props {
  screens: ScreenFrame[];
}

export function ScreenGrid({ screens }: Props) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [activePage, setActivePage] = useState<string>('__all__');

  const pages = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set(screens.map(s => s.pageName));
    return Array.from(set);
  }, [screens]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let result = screens;
    if (activePage !== '__all__') result = result.filter(s => s.pageName === activePage);
    if (search.trim()) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      result = result.filter(s => s.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    }
    return result;
  }, [screens, activePage, search]);

  return (
    <div className="grid-view">
      <div className="grid-controls">
        <div className="controls-row">
          <input
            className="search-input"
            type="search"
            placeholder="Search screens…"
            value={search}
            onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="screen-count">{filtered.length} screens</span>
        </div>
        <div className="page-tabs">
          <button
            className={`page-tab ${activePage === '__all__' ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setActivePage('__all__')}
          >
            All pages
          </button>
          {pages.map(p => (
            <button
              key={p}
              className={`page-tab ${activePage === p ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setActivePage(p)}
            >
              {p}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="empty-state">No screens match "{search}"</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="screen-grid">
          {filtered.map((screen, i) => (
            <ScreenCard key={screen.id} screen={screen} index={i} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```

```tsx
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
import { ScreenCard } from './ScreenCard';
import type { ScreenFrame } from '../types';

interface Props {
  screens: ScreenFrame[];
}

export function ScreenGrid({ screens }: Props) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [activePage, setActivePage] = useState<string>('__all__');
  const [device, setDevice] = useState<'mobile' | 'desktop'>('mobile');
  const [mobileColumns, setMobileColumns] = useState<number>(4);
  const [desktopColumns, setDesktopColumns] = useState<number>(3);
  const columns = device === 'mobile' ? mobileColumns : desktopColumns;

  const pages = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set(screens.map(s => s.pageName));
    return Array.from(set);
  }, [screens]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let result = screens;
    result = result.filter(s => (s as unknown as Record<string, string>)['kind'] === device);
    if (activePage !== '__all__') result = result.filter(s => s.pageName === activePage);
    if (search.trim()) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      result = result.filter(s => s.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    }
    return result;
  }, [screens, device, activePage, search]);

  return (
    <div className="grid-view">
      <div className="grid-controls">
        <div className="controls-row">
          <input
            className="search-input"
            type="search"
            placeholder="Search screens…"
            value={search}
            onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          />
          <span className="screen-count">{filtered.length} screens</span>
        </div>

        <div className="controls-row">
          <div className="page-tabs">
            <button
              className={`page-tab ${activePage === '__all__' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setActivePage('__all__')}
            >
              All pages
            </button>
            {pages.map(p => (
              <button
                key={p}
                className={`page-tab ${activePage === p ? 'active' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => setActivePage(p)}
              >
                {p}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="device-tabs">
            <button
              className={`device-tab page-tab ${device === 'mobile' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setDevice('mobile')}
            >
              Mobile
            </button>
            <button
              className={`device-tab page-tab ${device === 'desktop' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setDevice('desktop')}
            >
              Desktop
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="columns-control">
          <div className="columns-top">
            <span className="columns-label">Columns ({device})</span>
            <span className="columns-value">{columns}</span>
          </div>
          <input
            className="columns-range"
            type="range"
            min={1}
            max={6}
            step={1}
            value={columns}
            onChange={e => {
              const v = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
              if (device === 'mobile') setMobileColumns(v);
              else setDesktopColumns(v);
            }}
            aria-label="Columns per row"
          />
          <div className="columns-hint">Adjust gallery density</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="empty-state">No screens match "{search}"</div>
      ) : (
        <div
          className="screen-grid"
          style={{ '--columns': columns } as CSSProperties}
        >
          {filtered.map((screen, i) => (
            <ScreenCard key={screen.id} screen={screen} index={i} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```

/* ── Reset & Variables ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

:root {
  --bg:        #f6f7fb;
  --bg2:       #ffffff;
  --bg3:       #f1f3f7;
  --border:    #e7e9f0;
  --border2:   #d7dbe7;
  --text:      #0b1220;
  --text-dim:  #334155;
  --text-faint:#64748b;
  --accent:    #2563eb;
  --accent2:   #1d4ed8;
  --accent-glow: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.18);
  --red:       #dc2626;
  --mono:      'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, monospace;
  --display:   'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  --radius:    8px;
  --radius-lg: 14px;
}

html { font-size: 16px; }
body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: var(--mono);
  min-height: 100vh;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* ── Page layout — centered column with generous side whitespace ── */
.page-layout {
  width: min(1100px, 100% - 10rem);
  margin: 0 auto;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* ── Top section ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.top-section {
  padding: 3.5rem 0 2.5rem;
}

.top-header {
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.setup-eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--accent2);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
}

.setup-title {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 2.6rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: var(--text);
  line-height: 1;
}

.loaded-filename {
  margin-top: 0.4rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-faint);
  font-family: var(--mono);
}

/* ── Form — horizontal row ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.setup-form {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  flex: 0 0 220px;
}

.field--url {
  flex: 1;
}

.field--action {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.field label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.field input {
  background: var(--bg2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.72rem 1rem;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
  width: 100%;
}

.field input::placeholder { color: var(--text-faint); }

.field input:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-glow);
}

.field-hint {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--text-faint);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.field-error {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--red);
}

.error-banner {
  background: rgba(255, 91, 91, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 91, 91, 0.3);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--red);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.btn-load {
  background: var(--accent);
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  padding: 0.72rem 1.4rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.15s;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
}

.btn-load:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--accent2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(91,91,255,0.4);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-load:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); }
.btn-load:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

/* ── Grid view ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.grid-view {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease both;
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}

/* ── Controls — sticky below the fold ──────────────────────────── */
.grid-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding: 1.25rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--bg);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 9;
}

.controls-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.search-input {
  background: var(--bg2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  outline: none;
  padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
  width: 280px;
}

.search-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-faint); }
.search-input:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-glow);
}

.screen-count {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--text-faint);
  margin-left: auto;
}

.page-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.page-tab {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.75rem;
  transition: all 0.12s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.page-tab:hover { border-color: var(--border2); color: var(--text); }
.page-tab.active {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent-glow);
}

/* ── Columns control ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.columns-control {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding-top: 0.2rem;
}

.columns-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  max-width: 360px;
}

.columns-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--text-faint);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.columns-value {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--text);
}

.columns-range {
  appearance: none;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 360px;
  height: 24px;
  background: transparent;
}

.columns-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35), rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12));
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22);
}

.columns-range::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  appearance: none;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.45);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.16);
  margin-top: -6px;
}

.columns-hint {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--text-faint);
}

/* ── Device tabs ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.device-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

/* ── Screen grid ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.screen-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--columns, 4), minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1.1rem;
  padding: 1.8rem 0 2.5rem;
  align-items: start;
}

/* ── Screen card ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.screen-card {
  cursor: pointer;
  display: block;
  animation: cardIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: var(--delay, 0ms);
}

.screen-card[data-kind="mobile"] .screen-thumb {
  aspect-ratio: 9 / 16;
}

.screen-card[data-kind="desktop"] .screen-thumb {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
}

@keyframes cardIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.97); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}

.screen-thumb {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--bg3);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
  transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
}

.screen-card:hover .screen-thumb {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12), 0 0 0 1px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.screen-thumb img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.thumb-skeleton {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--bg3) 25%,
    var(--bg2) 50%,
    var(--bg3) 75%
  );
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: shimmer 1.4s infinite;
}

@keyframes shimmer {
  0%   { background-position: 200% 0; }
  100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
}

.thumb-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 2rem;
  opacity: 0.15;
}

.screen-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22), rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.04));
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.screen-card:hover .screen-overlay { opacity: 1; }

.thumb-bottom {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.7rem 0.75rem;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0));
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.thumb-title {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  color: #fff;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.thumb-page {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.72);
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.overlay-cta {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  background: var(--accent);
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 100px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}

/* ── Empty state ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.empty-state {
  padding: 4rem 0;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text-faint);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

/* ── Scrollbar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border2); border-radius: 3px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--text-faint); }

/* ── Responsive ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .page-layout {
    width: min(1100px, 100% - 3rem);
  }

  .setup-form {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .field,
  .field--url,
  .field--action {
    flex: none;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .screen-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
}
